# Openzess

> Openzess is an open-source, provider-agnostic autonomous AI workspace and cyberpunk terminal agent. It lets developers run LLM-powered agents that reason, write code, remember, and execute real tasks on their machines — through a React 19 web workspace, a native terminal TUI, or a REST/WebSocket API. Licensed under MIT.

Core architectural pillars:

- [Zero provider lock-in](https://github.com/rosdebbu/openzess): Connect any LLM — GLM, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, Groq, Qwen, Kimi, or local Ollama / LM Studio.
- [Hybrid Python/Rust engine](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/guide/hybrid-engine): Python's AI ecosystem (LiteLLM, FastAPI, ChromaDB) plus a high-throughput Rust Axum sidecar.
- [Autonomous self-growth loop](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/features/habit-learner): The agent learns habits and preferences automatically and persists them into a ChromaDB vector vault that hydrates future prompts.
- [Multi-agent WarRoom & Debate Arena](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/features/swarm): Multi-model consensus debates where distinct agents argue, critique, and synthesize decisions before writing code.
- [Hot-loaded extensibility](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/features/custom-plugins): Drop Python scripts into `backend/app/plugins/` or connect any MCP (Model Context Protocol) server with instant reload.

## Quickstart

- [Getting Started](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/guide/getting-started): Install, configure, and boot the terminal CLI or the web workspace.
- [Cyberpunk Terminal CLI](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/features/terminal-cli): Run `openzess` (Linux/WSL2) or `.\openzess.bat` (Windows) for the Hermes-grade TUI with slash commands.
- [Web Workspace](https://github.com/rosdebbu/openzess): Run `.\start.bat` to launch the React 19 + FastAPI stack, then open http://localhost:5173.
- [Configuration](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/guide/configuration): Providers, API keys, personas, and tool authorization.

## Key API endpoints

- [REST API](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/api/rest-api): SSE chat streaming, sessions, memory, skills, and plugin endpoints served by the FastAPI backend.
- [OpenAI-compatible API](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/api/openai-compat): Drop-in `/v1/chat/completions` compatibility for existing OpenAI tooling.
- [WebSocket API](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/api/websocket): Matrix screen-stream and remote control channel.

- [Full documentation site](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/): Complete guides, feature references, and API docs.

- [Architecture guide](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/guide/architecture): System overview of the hybrid engine and codebase map.
- [Security & sandboxing](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/guide/security): How agent execution is sandboxed and tool calls are authorized.
- [Memory Vault (ChromaDB)](https://openzess-docs.vercel.app/features/memory-vault): Long-term semantic memory storage and search.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/rosdebbu/openzess): Source code, issues, and contribution guide (MIT licensed).
